meta.name: Bhaukaal
meta.description:
Naveen Sikhera makes his way into the sin city as the new SSP, he is hit by the prevailing chaos and lawlessness in the city. Muzaffarnagar is ruled by Shaukeen gang in the east and the Dedha brothers rule the west.

Rated U · Ended · First aired 6 Mar 2020 · India · Language: Hindi · 32 min
Studio: Applause Entertainment · Network: Prime Video, MX Player

Complete series. On your server: S1 10/10 | S2 10/10

On your server — Audio: Hindi

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: The dark, gory universe of Muzaffarnagar is ruled by Shaukeen and the Dedha Brothers. Loha Singh, a member of the Dedha clan is killed by Abbas, who is a close ally of Shaukeen. Around the same time, Naveen Sikhera is transferred as the new SSP to Muzaffarnagar, the crime capital of India. Shaukeen informs the Dedha brothers about Abbas' whereabouts, so that a gang-war can be avoided. As Naveen Sikhera reaches Muzaffarnagar, he is welcomed with the murder of Abbas and other innocent civilians by the Dedha brothers.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: An innocent man named Vinay Tyagi gets kidnapped by Shaukeen's gang. Naveen Sikhera joins duty as the SSP. Vinay Tyagi's father implores Sikhera to take action against the Shaukeen gang, who have demanded a huge ransom. Sikhera decides to visit the ghetto from where Shaukeen commands his power. As the battle lines are drawn between them after the first confrontation, Shaukeen is a bit shaken. To instil his fear on the SSP, he gets Vinay Tyagi beheaded and delivers the head at Sikhera's doorstep.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: After the death of Vinay Tyagi, the people of Muzaffarnagar have completely lost faith in the police. Naveen calls his team from Meerut to assist in his battle against the criminals and Salim is chosen to infiltrate Shaukeen's gang.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Bunty Jhaal is cornered by Sikhera's team but he escapes into a sugarcane field. As a series of police reforms, Naveen Sikhera decides to revoke the cases of 'history-sheeters'. Not only that, in the defunct police station of Muzaffarnagar, a mobile phone tracing centre is set up under inspector Vinod. Soon, the centre taps Farooq's call with Rashid Khan and in a massive encounter, Rashid and his henchmen are killed by Sikhera's team. This worries Shaukeen as the clouds of danger start gathering on their fortress.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: The police have upped the ante against the bastions of crime. Cracks have appeared in Hussainpur, as the rift between Farooq and Naazneen, Shaukeen's mistress have started increasing. Aslam Rana, the politician backing Shaukeen seems anxious by the police actions. He pressurizes Shaukeen to take action against Sikhera. Shaukeen, decides to entrap the SSP by involving Bunty Jhaal. Whether it is Bunty Jhaal or Sikhera, who is killed, Shaukeen is the one who will gain.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: The Police team proceeds to catch Bunty, ending up in a massive encounter, leading to the criminal's death. Without hampering their efforts, the SSP's team traps Gurjan, Dedha's man. They also get to know that Pintoo Dedha is coming back to Muzaffarnagar hence, they decide to capture him.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Pintoo Dedha successfully escapes. Sikhera realises there is a traitor in their department. Salim successfully makes his way into Shaukeen's house. Farooq feels that the terror and influence of Shaukeen gang is waning. In the absence of Shaukeen who is in Nepal, he decides to kidnap Vikram Tyagi and extort money from his father. As they head to Salarpur, Salim manages to inform his team. Dedha brothers meet their police source, who advises them to remain calm as the SSP's attention is presently focussed on the Shaukeen gang.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Farooq shakes the Tyagi house, by kidnapping Vikram Tyagi. Saleem imform to Naveen sikhera & in tyagi's house saleem protest tyagi's daughter in- laws . Sikhera & team reached tyagi's house but farooq manage to escape.He realises that there is a mole amongst them reporting to the police. While Vikram Tyagi's father is called by Farooq with the ransom, Sikhera and his team follow the old man. Farooq is taken under custody while Vikram Tyagi is brutally murdered. On the other hand, Sikhera gets instructions from the IG to halt all operations.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: When Naveen Sikhera is questioned by the authority, he is all for his men. The IG commands Naveen to escort the deputy CM. Shaukeen is back from Nepal and he decides to free Farooq from the premises of the court. Since, Naveen Sikhera has been diverted to the rally of Deputy CM, he entrusts Rajesh, his driver with the responsibility of taking Farooq to the court. A massive encounter takes place in the court between police and the goons, Farooq tries to escape but Rajesh kills him; sacrificing his own life in the process. What ensues is a massive operation which ...

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Salim mixes a drug in Shaukeen's soup and abducts him to a distant field. When Sikhera reaches the location, he finds Salim hanging on a tree. What follows is a massive action sequence of crossfire and the outcome is the dead body of Shaukeen.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: In this episode, Naveen is all set to face the challenges of taking out the Dedha brothers as he targets them to be his next mission to eradicate crime from the city of Muzaffarnagar. On the other hand, the Dedha brothers will do everything in their power to maintain their ‘Bhaukaal’ among the public which they now feel is being eradicated slowly. They take extensive measures to make sure that does not happen. What measures are they taking? Does it come with more challenges and more lives to save for Naveen?

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: In this episode, Ashok, one of the members of Dedha brother’s gang, narrowly escapes Naveen and his team but they get a hold of their weapons. This infuriates the Dedha brothers and they ask their mole planted in Naveen’s team to give them his exact schedule. They are now planning to hit back at him. What does Naveen need to be aware of? Taking such a huge risk of taking the Dedha brothers might cost him more than he thought. What is coming his way?

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: In this episode, Naveen and his wife get into a dangerous accident when his car is hit by a truck. Even though he has escaped the accident with minor injuries, his wife, who was also pregnant, is now in critical condition. He is extremely disturbed and decides to get non-bailable warrants from Judge Tavar, a newly appointed and righteous man. The brothers get to know Naveen’s course of plan and they appoint Azhar to execute their plan. What is Azhar asked to do?

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: In this episode, a lot is happening around Naveen and he cannot seem to get a hold of the situation. Judge Tavar lies in front of him in a critical condition and he has no clue as to how it happened. On the other hand, the Dedha brothers are ready to go to any extent to maintain their ‘Bhaukaal’ (fear) amongst the public. In their next course of action, they catch all the animals from the city and lock them inside so that the people are not able to earn a livelihood. What more do these brothers have planned and how many more lives are they ready to sacrifice for their status?

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: In this episode, Naveen is on his toes and will not rest until he finds out who is causing all these murders around him. He appoints other men on his task force to come up with a plan and wants them to find out how the Dedha brothers earn their money. By doing this, he aims to choke their monetary supplies and put pressure on them. Will his strategy work? Meanwhile, Pintu is holding a newborn child and that stops Balram from shooting him. What will happen next?

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: In this episode, Tiwari decides to hold a press conference and it all seems like a plot to humiliate Naveen publically. He accuses Naveen to be responsible for the kidnapping and Naveen has no answers or evidence to counter his claims. On the other hand, Dr Tiwari asks other doctors that he knows to pay protection money to the Dedha brothers. Will he be able to convince enough doctors?

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: In this episode, the Dedhas cross all limits and cause a massacre in Shaukeen’s house by shooting anyone and everyone they see. Somehow Ashfaq and Naaz find a way to escape but there are others in the house that will, unfortunately, come under their wrath. On the other hand, Pooja goes into labor while Naveen is still aghast to look at the massacre spreading slowly in Hussainpur. Will he be able to stop the Dedhas in time or will have to watch as the city will burn?

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: In this episode, Naveen is under the radar of the police as well since he is responsible for enriching the Dedha brothers. He is given one last chance by the DGP to end what he started and for that, he will do anything. Dedha brothers come to know that Naveen is now transferred and the first thing they do is to go and get money from Vijayraj and Mickey Kapoor that denied them the money earlier. Naveen is back in Muzzaffarnagar and decides to visit Vijayraj’s shop when he finds him murdered point-blank by Chintu Dedha. He takes an oath to not see the face of his newborn until he finishes the Dedha brothers for good. Will he be able to keep his oath? Will the Dedha brothers know that he is back in town?

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: In this episode, Gurjan finally switches on his phone to take pictures and his location is traced then and there. Naveen heads towards him and he is killed in this chase. On the other hand, Bhati tries to encourage Vikas to choose books over guns in his life and that is the only way to go. Meanwhile, Chintu is back in Muzaffarnagar with all of Mickey Kapoor’s money while Naveen plans an attack on Pintu’s house and he tells everyone in the team their course of action, including Sunil. Will they be able to execute the plan effectively?

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: In this episode, Pintu is informed by Sunil about their plan to attack him and he sends his wife and daughter to a safe house. Meanwhile, Naveen gets Sunil arrested since he was already aware that he was the mole. They begin the attack on Pintu’s house to capture him. On the other hand, Neha captures Rana’s meeting that will prove his connection to the massacres happening in the city. Naveen is close to catching Pintu and suddenly Chintu arrives at the scene that takes Pintu’s attention away. Naveen uses this opportunity to kill his men and take hold of the situation. Will Naveen be able to achieve his goal?
